observations.summary: setRatio(50) succeeds — ratio can equal MAX_RATIO (50), contradicting the NatSpec that documents a strict '< MAX_RATIO' bound. The fuzz harness confirms ratio reaches exactly 50. Economic safety bound (ratio <= 50, i.e. at most 50% of dispatched USDS becomes phUSD debt) holds; this is a spec/implementation deviation, not a value-loss bug. No counterexample for an over-50% mint exists.
